headline: [Airspace Alert!] Japan Scrambles Fighters as Suspected [Russian Planes] Enter
caption:
✈️ Airspace Alert! Japan Scrambles Fighters as Suspected Russian Planes Enter

Two suspected Russian military aircraft entered Japanese airspace near Okinoshima, an island off Fukuoka in southwestern Japan, at about 4 a.m. local time on Tuesday, November 17. Japan sent fighter jets, which warned the planes by radio. Each plane stayed in Japanese airspace for about three minutes.

🔹 Japan said it is the first violation of its airspace by Russian aircraft since September 2024. Tokyo lodged a "very stern protest" with Russia.
🔹 Defence Minister Shinjiro Koizumi called it "a serious violation of our sovereignty" and "utterly unacceptable".
🔹 South Korea also sent fighter jets after Russian aircraft entered its air defence zone, but said its airspace was not violated. Leaders of Japan and Russia are both expected at the APEC summit in China this week.

💬 Why do you think this happened right before the APEC summit? 👇

Sources: AFP, Jiji Press, Japan Times

headline: [Major Strike!] Ukraine Hits Crimea Bridge Again, Zelensky Says Section [Collapsed]
caption:
🚨 BREAKING: Ukraine Hits Crimea Bridge Again, Zelensky Says Section Collapsed

Ukraine attacked the Crimean Bridge (Kerch Bridge), the only road link between southern Russia and occupied Crimea, for the second day in a row on Tuesday, November 17. President Volodymyr Zelensky called the attack "unprecedented" and shared video he said shows the bridge's main road arch and part of the roadway collapsed. Reuters said it could not verify the footage.

🔹 Crimea's Russian-installed governor, Sergei Aksyonov, said two people were killed and traffic on the bridge was suspended.
🔹 Russia said it shot down 1,441 Ukrainian drones over 22 regions overnight, a new record. Russia also struck two bridges in Kyiv, causing some power and water cuts.
🔹 Zelensky said the attack was a response to Russian strikes on Ukraine's infrastructure. It comes days before Putin, Xi Jinping and Donald Trump are due to meet in China.

💬 What will this mean for the talks in China this week? 👇

Sources: Reuters, Al Jazeera, CNN

#GlobalEye #Ukraine #Russia #Crimea #KerchBridge #WorldNews
photo_needed: The Crimean Bridge (Kerch Bridge) over the Kerch Strait, ideally showing the damaged/collapsed road section, or a wide view of the bridge. Wide landscape photo.

headline: [Shock Exit!] Mongolia's President [Khurelsukh] Resigns Over Corruption Claims
sub: He denies $25M bribe claim; parliament to vote
caption:
🏛️ Shock Exit! Mongolia's President Khurelsukh Resigns Over Corruption Claims

Mongolia's President Ukhnaa Khurelsukh, 58, announced his resignation on Tuesday, November 17, in an address to the nation. He faces corruption allegations, which he denies. "I have never stolen from my people or my state," he said, adding that he will cooperate with investigators.

🔹 Former Ulaanbaatar mayor Nyambaatar Khishgee, from a rival faction of the ruling Mongolian People's Party, accused him of receiving $25 million linked to a 2019 railway contract given without a competitive tender while he was prime minister. The company named, Bodi International, denies paying bribes.
🔹 The opposition Democratic Party had called for him to resign and wants an inquiry into money flows from the mining sector.
🔹 The resignation takes effect only if parliament accepts it, with a vote expected this week. If accepted, the speaker of parliament becomes interim president.

💬 Was resigning the right move while the claims are investigated? 👇

Sources: AP, Bloomberg, DPA

#GlobalEye #Mongolia #Khurelsukh #Politics #WorldNews

headline: [Sanctions Hit!] UK Freezes Assets of [8 Israeli Firms] Building West Bank Settlements
sub: Group accused of blocking Gaza aid also hit
caption:
⚖️ Sanctions Hit! UK Freezes Assets of 8 Israeli Firms Building West Bank Settlements

The UK government on Tuesday, November 17, announced sanctions on eight Israeli property and construction companies that build homes in West Bank settlements. It also sanctioned Tzav 9, an Israeli activist group the UK says has repeatedly blocked aid trucks heading into Gaza. All nine face asset freezes in the UK, and people linked to them are barred from serving as directors of UK companies.

🔹 Foreign Secretary Ed Miliband said "illegal settlement expansion in the West Bank is destroying the prospects of a two-state solution." His message to firms about the E1 settlement project east of Jerusalem: "do not bid, do not build, and do not profit from the destruction of the two-state solution."
🔹 The sanctions came shortly before the deadline for bids to build homes in E1. Britain says the project would cut East Jerusalem off from Palestinian areas of the West Bank.
🔹 Israel's government had no immediate comment. Israel Ganz, head of the Yesha settlers' council, said the UK had "declared economic war against Israel." These are the first concrete steps of wider UK measures announced in September.

💬 Will sanctions like these change anything on the ground? 👇

Sources: AP, Al Jazeera, Times of Israel

#GlobalEye #UK #Israel #WestBank #Sanctions #WorldNews
